scope: Software and fixed-scenario verification; not heat-flux calibration or operational wildfire validation
missing_previous_burn_timing: unresolved activity and conditional bounds by default; explicit opt-out available
reported_reference: Benali et al. 2023, PT-FireSprd section 3.1 median reconstructed forward ROS
reference_scope: Spread observations from 80 large mainland Portuguese wildfires in 2015-2021; not a universal speed or Fish Creek measurement
cell_duration_equation: T_cell = (abs(n dot u) + abs(n dot v)) / spread_rate_m_s + T_point
emission_profile: uniform whole-cell rectangular pulse using supplied arrival as cell burn start
energy_policy: fuel_load * consumed_fraction * heat_of_combustion is preserved; conditional source power is divided by cell duration
regression_environment: Final run allowed OpenMP shared-memory initialization after two sandbox subprocess checks encountered OMP Error 179
export_checks: Global previous-burning helper agrees with integrated heat state
Previous and new source fluxes sum to total mean and endpoint flux
Incident energy equals mean flux times 3600 seconds
WGS84 latitude-longitude coordinates agree with projected-cell centers
Cropped CSV matrices match full-grid array slices
All PNG figures are readable and the A/B figure was visually inspected
